briefVerification.evidence: Allowances are derived from the committed baseline and pin. Expansion, substitutions, working pin edits and reintroductions after a committed shrink are rejected. Non-baseline hashes fail with path:line and SHA-256 diagnostics. Existing storage, prototype, watermark and global-hook checks retain their logic. Lot 2 must empty the baseline.

prepublishOnly refuses a nonempty baseline unless an unchanged committed override names an owner and GO decision and matches version, current UTC date and baseline digest. Refusal, override acceptance, empty-baseline acceptance and invalid overrides pass regression tests. The real hook refuses the current baseline.

Only baseline hashes on the named lot 0 branch, within main..HEAD and unreachable from remote refs, receive a local history exception. Main, other branches, remote-reachable commits and non-baseline hashes remain strict. Missing main fails closed. Two pre-existing main-history occurrences still fail as required.
